templates.description: Transparent avatar workflow that uses PuLID for face identity and a padded body reference depth map through SDXL ControlNet, saves an RGB fallback, then removes the background.

variables.name: positive_prompt
variables.description: Rendered avatar scene prompt.

variables.name: face_reference_image
variables.description: Reference image for PuLID face identity.

variables.name: body_reference_image
variables.description: Reference image for body proportions, pose, and silhouette depth guidance.

variables.name: face_strength
variables.description: PuLID face identity weight from 0 to 1.

variables.name: pulid_model
variables.description: Local PuLID SDXL model filename from the ComfyUI pulid model folder.

variables.name: pulid_provider
variables.description: InsightFace execution provider for PuLID face analysis.

variables.name: pulid_projection
variables.description: PuLID projection mode.

variables.name: pulid_fidelity
variables.description: PuLID fidelity value. Lower values bias toward stronger resemblance; higher values allow more prompt freedom.

variables.name: pulid_noise
variables.description: Optional PuLID noise amount.

variables.name: pulid_start_at
variables.description: Sampler percentage where PuLID identity guidance begins applying.

variables.name: pulid_end_at
variables.description: Sampler percentage where PuLID identity guidance stops applying.

variables.name: body_depth_strength
variables.description: Body depth ControlNet strength from 0 to 1. Higher values follow the body reference depth map more strongly.

variables.name: body_depth_start
variables.description: Sampler percentage where body depth ControlNet begins applying.

variables.name: body_depth_end
variables.description: Sampler percentage where body depth ControlNet stops applying.

variables.name: depth_resolution
variables.description: Resolution used by the Depth Anything V2 preprocessor.

variables.name: depth_anything_model
variables.description: Depth Anything V2 annotator checkpoint filename.

variables.name: body_depth_controlnet
variables.description: Local SDXL depth ControlNet model filename.

variables.name: negative_prompt
variables.description: Prompt terms to suppress.

variables.name: avatar_name
variables.description: Filesystem-safe avatar name used in output filenames.

variables.name: bg_removal_model
variables.description: Local ComfyUI background-removal model filename.

variables.name: width
variables.description: Output width.

variables.name: height
variables.description: Output height.

variables.name: seed
variables.description: Sampler seed. Use null for runtime randomization.

variables.name: steps
variables.description: Sampler step count.

variables.name: cfg
variables.description: Classifier-free guidance scale.

variables.name: denoise
variables.description: Sampler denoise. This template starts from empty latent, so 1.0 gives the cleanest new composition.

defaults.negative_prompt: busy background, detailed background, cropped head, cropped face, cropped body, out of frame, close-up crop, torso crop, missing legs, missing feet, different body shape, changed identity, altered face, low quality, blurry, distorted face, distorted hands, extra limbs, malformed body, watermark, text
